title.narrative: MR:INTEGRATED DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR IRRIGATED AGRIC. APL # 2

description.narrative: The Integrated Development Program for Irrigated Agriculture for Mauritania aims to: (1) consolidate key incentive measures, (2) increase sustainable irrigation schemes, and (3) intensify agricultural diversification for targeted actors engaged in irrigated agriculture. The project has the following four components: Component 1) will consolidate the policy measures and incentives initiated during Phase I, and improve the capacity of national and regional rural institutions to implement the Program. Component 2) will provide technical services and investment funds to land owners to expand irrigation schemes, along with secure land tenure and capacity building provided in other components. Component 3) will provide the necessary assistance to develop a competitive rice sub-sector and a diversified agricultural base, targeting rice and horticultural supply chain participants engaged in domestic and export markets. Component 4) will ensure the proper coordination of project activities, the monitoring of activities and evaluation of impacts, and the implementation of the social and environmental safeguards.
To improve availability of critical agricultural inputs and food staples for targeted beneficiaries.
